notes: EXAMPLE DATA. Crate types, inflows (crates/hour), pallet quantities, offsets, shaft capacities, and shuttle kinematics are illustrative assumptions for this prototype. They are not measurements from a warehouse. Indexes in these files are one-based (segment 1 is the leftmost rack). Default geometry: 12 segments x 5 levels x 9 shafts. Shuttle 1 home is the left end at level 1; shuttle 2 home is the right end at level 1.
